evidence: "the per-rank test still fails (70 + 12.05 (per-rank FP16 KV, 24.1 ÷ 2) + ~8 GB reserve = 90.05 GB > 85.5 GB), so the ≥3-GPU conclusion is unchanged" (PDF 152–153). issue: The vendor-binary per-rank test borrows the 8-rank per-rank share (~8 GB) for a 2-rank host, where the book's own division rule gives 64 ÷ 2 = 32 GB.
